policy: Reference snapshots are inert data; use only the native adaptations for implementation. Exact source bytes preserved; helper scripts have .source.txt suffix and no executable mode. No vendor runtime or workflow installed.

skills.title: Declarative native environment blueprints
skills.description: Reconstruct portable setup recipes and isolated fixtures; do not install WordPress Playground.
skills.exclude: No Playground bundle installer, wp:false runtime adoption or new /install feature until approved core acceptance.

skills.title: Source-backed native workflow router
skills.description: Choose the correct reverse-engineering skill and canonical Nebo component before changes.
skills.exclude: No WordPress/theme/plugin scaffolding; no routing based solely on user wording or copying a vendor install command.

skills.title: Native ability registry and transport projections
skills.description: Reconstruct versioned capability registration, category, discovery, permissions and adapters.
skills.exclude: No WordPress functions, plugin loader, parallel duplicate registry, broad external MCP transport before authorization is proven.

skills.title: Audit the native route-to-capability inventory
skills.description: Derive a structured audit of semantic domain operations and actual gates before scaffolding.
skills.exclude: No general WooCommerce parity; no auto-exposing every admin endpoint, no guessing from REST names or static counts.

skills.title: Adversarial ability contract verification
skills.description: Verify schemas, permissions, annotations and side effects at actual boundaries.
skills.exclude: No fabricated verification, no provider challenge credited as business ability acceptance, no broad production destructive probes.

skills.title: Design typed domain operations
skills.description: Define stable caller-oriented input/output and recovery semantics before registration.
skills.exclude: No direct model writes or price guessing, no unsupported schema keywords hidden by adapter coercion.

skills.title: Native section/component development
skills.description: Reconstruct typed reusable content sections and render contracts, not Gutenberg runtime.
skills.exclude: No Gutenberg dependency, block-comment compatibility or npm production build.

skills.title: Canonical site profile, templates and design tokens
skills.description: Trace configuration precedence and template parts for reusable PHP layouts.
skills.exclude: No WordPress Site Editor, theme install or arbitrary theme code; installer remains deferred.

skills.title: Isolated PHP/MySQL fixture environments
skills.description: Adapt reproducible environment setup and validation to the native stack.
skills.exclude: No wp-env, Docker or WordPress installation requirement. Do not alter shared-host production configuration to satisfy a fixture.

skills.title: Native reactive state, events and hydration
skills.description: Reconstruct server/client state and safe interaction boundaries for A2UI and existing UI.
skills.exclude: No @wordpress/interactivity package, data-wp runtime or arbitrary model-generated executable markup.

skills.title: Reusable native content patterns
skills.description: Reverse engineer reusable page composition and safe editor insertions.
skills.exclude: No block markup, plugin registration or new commerce/catalog features; patterns cannot execute arbitrary scripts or payment actions.

skills.title: Native performance measurement and optimization
skills.description: Measure actual route, query, cache, scheduled job and provider cost; adapt Site Kit reporting.
skills.exclude: No WP-CLI profiling plugin, Redis requirement, new background process or paid service; no synthetic analytics shown as live.

skills.title: Native PHP type and static-contract review
skills.description: Adapt static typing and analysis to the existing PHP codebase without WordPress stubs.
skills.exclude: No Composer or WordPress runtime requirement; no blanket ignoreErrors, generated fake stubs or claimed PHPStan pass without running.

skills.title: Isolated native execution and browser verification
skills.description: Separate reference research, local execution, WebMCP and actual live acceptance.
skills.exclude: No Playground installation, external site snapshot containing customer data, unapproved share links or new hosting service.

skills.title: Native service/module lifecycle and migration
skills.description: Reconstruct component boundaries, lifecycle, settings, security and scheduled operations without plugins.
skills.exclude: No plugin activation hooks, arbitrary extension installer, vendor PHP execution, or uninstall wiping customer data.

skills.title: Native release policy, licensing and security review
skills.description: Use directory-guideline lessons for product release review, not WordPress directory submission.
skills.exclude: No directory submission, Plugin Check dependency, or generic legal compliance guarantee.

skills.title: Native repo triage and evidence inventory
skills.description: Classify source, runtime surfaces, data ownership and gaps before engineering.
skills.exclude: No WordPress project classification assumptions, automatic code scaffold, or broad scans/rewrites of unrelated customer projects.

skills.title: Native HTTP contracts and permission gates
skills.description: Reconstruct route registration, validation, stable responses and authorization across API/MCP boundaries.
skills.exclude: No wp-json runtime, duplicate controllers for agent/MCP, or arbitrary SQL/filesystem access.

skills.title: Native CLI and deployment operations
skills.description: Adapt safe targeting, backups, dry runs, cron and release verification to bapXcms.
skills.exclude: No WP-CLI, multisite conversion, arbitrary command runner, production bulk search-replace or installer until approved.

skills.title: Native design system and A2UI catalog
skills.description: Extract design-system patterns, typed components and accessibility without WordPress Design System runtime.
skills.exclude: No WPDS MCP server install, CSS framework migration or unverified claim of A2UI compatibility.

skills.title: Native ability implementation from audited domain services
skills.description: Adapt the WooCommerce implementation playbook to clinic service booking and shared native abilities.
skills.exclude: No general WooCommerce parity, extension scaffold, plugin lifecycle, cart/inventory/shipping/marketing expansion or vendor installation.

skills.title: Evidence-backed issue and stale PR reconciliation
skills.description: Adapt the fixed-cohort audit to the native repository and avoid replaying or discarding unique work.
skills.exclude: No automatic closure/merge of upstream PRs, no deleting dirty branches or worktrees; no use of upstream scripts, no expansion of WooCommerce product scope.
